name: QuartetDistance.RibbonRestriction.LinearInterval.circular
statement:
theorem LinearInterval.circular [DecidableEq α] {S : Finset α} {word : List α}
    (h : LinearInterval S word) : CircularInterval S word
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨before, middle, after, hword, hmiddle⟩ := h
  exact ⟨before, middle, after, hword, Or.inl hmiddle⟩

name: QuartetDistance.RibbonRestriction.frontier_block_of_isSubtree
proof:
:= by
  induction hut generalizing word with
  | here t =>
      exact ⟨word, hword, [], [], by simp⟩
  | left r hut ih =>
      simp only [Tree.FullTree.frontierProfile_fork,
        Tree.FullTree.joinProfile, Multiset.mem_bind] at hword
      obtain ⟨leftWord, hleft, rightWord, hright, hword⟩ := hword
      simp at hword
      obtain ⟨middle, hmiddle, before, after, hleftEq⟩ := ih hleft
      rcases hword with rfl | rfl
      · refine ⟨middle, hmiddle, before, after ++ rightWord, ?_⟩
        simp [hleftEq, List.append_assoc]
      · refine ⟨middle, hmiddle, rightWord ++ before, after, ?_⟩
        simp [hleftEq, List.append_assoc]
  | right l hut ih =>
      simp only [Tree.FullTree.frontierProfile_fork,
        Tree.FullTree.joinProfile, Multiset.mem_bind] at hword
      obtain ⟨leftWord, hleft, rightWord, hright, hword⟩ := hword
      simp at hword
      obtain ⟨middle, hmiddle, before, after, hrightEq⟩ := ih hright
      rcases hword with rfl | rfl
      · refine ⟨middle, hmiddle, leftWord ++ before, after, ?_⟩
        simp [hrightEq, List.append_assoc]
      · refine ⟨middle, hmiddle, before, after ++ leftWord, ?_⟩
        simp [hrightEq, List.append_assoc]

name: QuartetDistance.RibbonRestriction.linearInterval_leaves_of_isSubtree
statement:
theorem linearInterval_leaves_of_isSubtree [DecidableEq α]
    {u t : Tree.FullTree α} (hut : IsSubtree u t) {word : List α}
    (hword : word ∈ t.frontierProfile) :
    LinearInterval u.leaves.toFinset word
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨middle, hmiddle, before, after, hEq⟩ :=
    frontier_block_of_isSubtree hut hword
  refine ⟨before, middle, after, hEq, ?_⟩
  exact List.toFinset_eq_of_perm middle u.leaves
    (u.mem_frontierProfile_perm hmiddle)

name: QuartetDistance.RibbonRestriction.outside_block_toFinset
statement:
private theorem outside_block_toFinset [DecidableEq α]
    (before middle after : List α)
    (hn : (before ++ middle ++ after).Nodup) :
    (after ++ before).toFinset =
      (before ++ middle ++ after).toFinset \ middle.toFinset
proof:
:= by
  have hbeforeMiddle : before.Disjoint middle :=
    ((List.nodup_append.mp hn).1).disjoint
  have hbeforeMiddleAfter : (before ++ middle).Disjoint after := hn.disjoint
  have hmiddleAfter : middle.Disjoint after := by
    rw [List.disjoint_left] at hbeforeMiddleAfter ⊢
    intro a haMiddle haAfter
    exact hbeforeMiddleAfter (by simp [haMiddle]) haAfter
  ext a
  simp only [List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_append, Finset.mem_sdiff]
  constructor
  · intro ha
    constructor
    · rcases ha with ha | ha
      · exact Or.inr ha
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ha)
    · rcases ha with ha | ha
      · exact (List.disjoint_left.mp hmiddleAfter.symm) ha
      · exact (List.disjoint_left.mp hbeforeMiddle) ha
  · rintro ⟨ha, hnot⟩
    rcases ha with (ha | ha) | ha
    · exact Or.inr ha
    · exact False.elim (hnot ha)
    · exact Or.inl ha

name: QuartetDistance.RibbonRestriction.circularInterval_complement_of_isSubtree
statement:
theorem circularInterval_complement_of_isSubtree [DecidableEq α]
    {u t : Tree.FullTree α} (hut : IsSubtree u t) {word : List α}
    (hword : word ∈ t.frontierProfile) (hn : word.Nodup) :
    CircularInterval (t.leaves.toFinset \ u.leaves.toFinset) word
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨middle, hmiddle, before, after, hEq⟩ :=
    frontier_block_of_isSubtree hut hword
  have hmiddleFinset : middle.toFinset = u.leaves.toFinset :=
    List.toFinset_eq_of_perm middle u.leaves
      (u.mem_frontierProfile_perm hmiddle)
  have hwholeFinset : word.toFinset = t.leaves.toFinset :=
    List.toFinset_eq_of_perm word t.leaves
      (t.mem_frontierProfile_perm hword)
  refine ⟨before, middle, after, hEq, Or.inr ?_⟩
  calc
    (after ++ before).toFinset = word.toFinset \ middle.toFinset := by
      rw [hEq]
      exact outside_block_toFinset before middle after (hEq ▸ hn)
    _ = t.leaves.toFinset \ u.leaves.toFinset := by
      rw [hwholeFinset, hmiddleFinset]

name: QuartetDistance.RibbonRestriction.restrictList_mem_optionProfile_of_mem_frontier
statement:
theorem restrictList_mem_optionProfile_of_mem_frontier [DecidableEq α]
    (t : Tree.FullTree α) (S : Finset α) {word : List α}
    (hword : word ∈ t.frontierProfile) :
    Tree.FullTree.restrictList S word ∈
      Tree.FullTree.optionProfile (Tree.FullTree.prune t S)
proof:
:= by
  have hmapped : Tree.FullTree.restrictList S word ∈
      t.frontierProfile.map (Tree.FullTree.restrictList S) :=
    Multiset.mem_map.mpr ⟨word, hword, rfl⟩
  rw [Tree.FullTree.map_restrictList_frontierProfile] at hmapped
  exact (Multiset.mem_nsmul.mp hmapped).2

name: QuartetDistance.RibbonRestriction.exists_frontier_lift_of_mem_optionProfile
statement:
theorem exists_frontier_lift_of_mem_optionProfile [DecidableEq α]
    (t : Tree.FullTree α) (S : Finset α) {restricted : List α}
    (hrestricted : restricted ∈
      Tree.FullTree.optionProfile (Tree.FullTree.prune t S)) :
    ∃ word, word ∈ t.frontierProfile ∧
      Tree.FullTree.restrictList S word = restricted
proof:
:= by
  have hpositive : 2 ^ Tree.FullTree.suppressedForks t S ≠ 0 := by
    positivity
  have hscaled : restricted ∈
      (2 ^ Tree.FullTree.suppressedForks t S) •
        Tree.FullTree.optionProfile (Tree.FullTree.prune t S) :=
    Multiset.mem_nsmul.mpr ⟨hpositive, hrestricted⟩
  rw [← Tree.FullTree.map_restrictList_frontierProfile] at hscaled
  exact Multiset.mem_map.mp hscaled

name: QuartetDistance.RibbonRestriction.mem_asFullTree_frontierProfile_of_mem_boundaryProfile
statement:
theorem mem_asFullTree_frontierProfile_of_mem_boundaryProfile
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (T : Tree.PhyloTree α)
    {word : List α} (hword : word ∈ T.boundaryProfile) :
    word ∈ T.asFullTree.frontierProfile
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Tree.PhyloTree.boundaryProfile, Multiset.mem_map] at hword
  obtain ⟨crownWord, hcrown, rfl⟩ := hword
  rw [T.asFullTree_frontierProfile]
  apply Multiset.mem_bind.mpr
  refine ⟨crownWord, hcrown, ?_⟩
  simp

name: QuartetDistance.RibbonRestriction.asFullTree_leaves_toFinset_eq_univ
statement:
theorem asFullTree_leaves_toFinset_eq_univ
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (T : Tree.PhyloTree α) :
    T.asFullTree.leaves.toFinset = Finset.univ
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  simp only [List.mem_toFinset, Finset.mem_univ, iff_true]
  exact T.mem_asFullTree_leaves a

name: QuartetDistance.RibbonRestriction.boundary_linearInterval_edgeSide
proof:
:=
  linearInterval_leaves_of_isSubtree hu
    (mem_asFullTree_frontierProfile_of_mem_boundaryProfile T hword)

name: QuartetDistance.RibbonRestriction.boundary_circularInterval_oppositeEdgeSide
proof:
:= by
  have h := circularInterval_complement_of_isSubtree hu
    (mem_asFullTree_frontierProfile_of_mem_boundaryProfile T hword)
    (T.mem_boundaryProfile_nodup hword)
  rwa [asFullTree_leaves_toFinset_eq_univ T] at h

name: QuartetDistance.RibbonRestriction.restrict_boundary_mem_restrictedTree_frontier
statement:
theorem restrict_boundary_mem_restrictedTree_frontier
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (T : Tree.PhyloTree α) (Q : Finset α) (hQ : Q.card = 4)
    {word : List α} (hword : word ∈ T.boundaryProfile) :
    Tree.FullTree.restrictList Q word ∈
      (T.restrictedTree Q hQ).frontierProfile
proof:
:= by
  have hfull := mem_asFullTree_frontierProfile_of_mem_boundaryProfile T hword
  have hpruned := restrictList_mem_optionProfile_of_mem_frontier
    T.asFullTree Q hfull
  rw [T.prune_asFullTree_eq_restrictedTree Q hQ] at hpruned
  exact hpruned

name: QuartetDistance.RibbonRestriction.crossing_restriction_mem_restrictedTree_crossingProfile
statement:
theorem crossing_restriction_mem_restrictedTree_crossingProfile
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (T : Tree.PhyloTree α) (Q : Finset α) (hQ : Q.card = 4)
    {word : List α} (hword : word ∈ T.boundaryProfile) :
    Tree.FullTree.crossingList (Tree.FullTree.restrictList Q word) ∈
      (T.restrictedTree Q hQ).crossingProfile
proof:
:= by
  apply Multiset.mem_map.mpr
  exact ⟨Tree.FullTree.restrictList Q word,
    restrict_boundary_mem_restrictedTree_frontier T Q hQ hword, rfl⟩

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.leaves_leaf
statement: @[simp] theorem leaves_leaf (a : α) : (leaf a).leaves = [a]
proof: := rfl

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.leaves_fork
statement:
@[simp] theorem leaves_fork (l r : FullTree α) :
    (fork l r).leaves = l.leaves ++ r.leaves
proof: := rfl

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.forks_leaf
statement: @[simp] theorem forks_leaf (a : α) : (leaf a).forks = 0
proof: := rfl

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.forks_fork
statement:
@[simp] theorem forks_fork (l r : FullTree α) :
    (fork l r).forks = l.forks + r.forks + 1
proof: := rfl

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.frontierProfile_leaf
statement:
@[simp] theorem frontierProfile_leaf (a : α) :
    (leaf a).frontierProfile = {[a]}
proof: := rfl

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.frontierProfile_fork
statement:
@[simp] theorem frontierProfile_fork (l r : FullTree α) :
    (fork l r).frontierProfile = joinProfile l.frontierProfile r.frontierProfile
proof: := rfl

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.joinProfile_add_left
statement:
theorem joinProfile_add_left (A B C : Multiset (List α)) :
    joinProfile (A + B) C = joinProfile A C + joinProfile B C
proof:
:= by
  simp [joinProfile, Multiset.add_bind]
  ac_rfl

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.joinProfile_nsmul_left
statement:
theorem joinProfile_nsmul_left (k : ℕ) (A B : Multiset (List α)) :
    joinProfile (k • A) B = k • joinProfile A B
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [joinProfile]
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [succ_nsmul, joinProfile_add_left, ih, succ_nsmul]

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.joinProfile_add_right
statement:
theorem joinProfile_add_right (A B C : Multiset (List α)) :
    joinProfile A (B + C) = joinProfile A B + joinProfile A C
proof:
:= by
  simp [joinProfile, Multiset.bind_add]
  ac_rfl

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.joinProfile_nsmul_right
statement:
theorem joinProfile_nsmul_right (k : ℕ) (A B : Multiset (List α)) :
    joinProfile A (k • B) = k • joinProfile A B
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [joinProfile]
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [succ_nsmul, joinProfile_add_right, ih, succ_nsmul]

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.joinProfile_nsmul
statement:
theorem joinProfile_nsmul (k m : ℕ) (A B : Multiset (List α)) :
    joinProfile (k • A) (m • B) = (k * m) • joinProfile A B
proof:
:= by
  rw [joinProfile_nsmul_left, joinProfile_nsmul_right]
  rw [← mul_nsmul, Nat.mul_comm]

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.joinProfile_singleton_nil_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem joinProfile_singleton_nil_left [DecidableEq α]
    (B : Multiset (List α)) :
    joinProfile {[]} B = 2 • B
proof:
:= by
  apply Multiset.ext.mpr
  intro xs
  simp [joinProfile, Multiset.count_nsmul]
  omega

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.joinProfile_singleton_nil_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem joinProfile_singleton_nil_right [DecidableEq α]
    (A : Multiset (List α)) :
    joinProfile A {[]} = 2 • A
proof:
:= by
  apply Multiset.ext.mpr
  intro xs
  have hid : A.bind (fun x => {x}) = A := by
    rw [Multiset.bind_singleton]
    exact Multiset.map_id A
  simp [joinProfile, Multiset.count_nsmul, hid]
  omega

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.leaves_ne_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem leaves_ne_nil (t : FullTree α) : t.leaves ≠ []
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | leaf => simp
  | fork l r ihl ihr => simp [leaves, ihl]

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.leaves_length_pos
statement: @[simp] theorem leaves_length_pos (t : FullTree α) : 0 < t.leaves.length
proof:
:= by
  have h : t.leaves.length ≠ 0 := by
    simp
  omega

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.mem_frontierProfile_length
statement:
theorem mem_frontierProfile_length (t : FullTree α) {xs : List α}
    (hxs : xs ∈ t.frontierProfile) : xs.length = t.leaves.length
proof:
:= by
  induction t generalizing xs with
  | leaf a =>
      simp only [frontierProfile_leaf, Multiset.mem_singleton] at hxs
      subst xs
      rfl
  | fork l r ihl ihr =>
      simp only [frontierProfile_fork, joinProfile, Multiset.mem_bind] at hxs
      obtain ⟨xl, hxl, xr, hxr, hxs⟩ := hxs
      simp at hxs
      rcases hxs with rfl | rfl
      · simp [ihl hxl, ihr hxr]
      · simp [ihl hxl, ihr hxr, Nat.add_comm]

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.mem_frontierProfile_perm
statement:
theorem mem_frontierProfile_perm (t : FullTree α) {xs : List α}
    (hxs : xs ∈ t.frontierProfile) : xs.Perm t.leaves
proof:
:= by
  induction t generalizing xs with
  | leaf a =>
      simp only [frontierProfile_leaf, Multiset.mem_singleton] at hxs
      subst xs
      rfl
  | fork l r ihl ihr =>
      simp only [frontierProfile_fork, joinProfile, Multiset.mem_bind] at hxs
      obtain ⟨xl, hxl, xr, hxr, hxs⟩ := hxs
      simp at hxs
      rcases hxs with rfl | rfl
      · exact (ihl hxl).append (ihr hxr)
      · exact ((ihr hxr).append (ihl hxl)).trans List.perm_append_comm

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.card_frontierProfile
statement:
@[simp] theorem card_frontierProfile (t : FullTree α) :
    t.frontierProfile.card = 2 ^ t.forks
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | leaf => simp [frontierProfile, forks]
  | fork l r ihl ihr =>
      simp [frontierProfile, forks, ihl, ihr, pow_add, Nat.mul_comm]
      omega

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.restrictList_nil
statement:
@[simp] theorem restrictList_nil [DecidableEq α] (S : Finset α) :
    restrictList S [] = []
proof: := rfl

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.restrictList_append
statement:
@[simp] theorem restrictList_append [DecidableEq α] (S : Finset α)
    (xs ys : List α) :
    restrictList S (xs ++ ys) = restrictList S xs ++ restrictList S ys
proof:
:= by
  simp [restrictList]

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.map_restrictList_joinProfile
statement:
theorem map_restrictList_joinProfile [DecidableEq α] (S : Finset α)
    (A B : Multiset (List α)) :
    (joinProfile A B).map (restrictList S) =
      joinProfile (A.map (restrictList S)) (B.map (restrictList S))
proof:
:= by
  simp [joinProfile, Multiset.map_bind, Multiset.bind_map, restrictList_append]

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.prune_leaf
statement:
@[simp] theorem prune_leaf [DecidableEq α] (S : Finset α) (a : α) :
    prune (leaf a) S = if a ∈ S then some (leaf a) else none
proof: := rfl

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.optionProfile_none
statement: @[simp] theorem optionProfile_none : optionProfile (none : Option (FullTree α)) = {[]}
proof: := rfl

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.optionProfile_some
statement:
@[simp] theorem optionProfile_some (t : FullTree α) :
    optionProfile (some t) = t.frontierProfile
proof: := rfl

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.map_restrictList_frontierProfile
statement:
theorem map_restrictList_frontierProfile [DecidableEq α]
    (t : FullTree α) (S : Finset α) :
    t.frontierProfile.map (restrictList S) =
      (2 ^ suppressedForks t S) • optionProfile (prune t S)
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | leaf a =>
      by_cases ha : a ∈ S <;> simp [frontierProfile, restrictList, prune, suppressedForks, ha,
        optionProfile]
  | fork l r ihl ihr =>
      rw [frontierProfile_fork, map_restrictList_joinProfile, ihl, ihr,
        joinProfile_nsmul]
      simp only [suppressedForks, prune]
      generalize hl : prune l S = ol
      generalize hr : prune r S = or
      cases ol <;> cases or <;>
        simp [optionProfile, pow_add, mul_nsmul, Nat.mul_comm]

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.restrictList_eq_nil_of_prune_eq_none
statement:
theorem restrictList_eq_nil_of_prune_eq_none [DecidableEq α]
    (t : FullTree α) (S : Finset α) (h : prune t S = none) :
    restrictList S t.leaves = []
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | leaf a =>
      simp only [prune_leaf] at h
      by_cases ha : a ∈ S <;> simp_all [restrictList]
  | fork l r ihl ihr =>
      simp only [prune] at h
      generalize hl : prune l S = ol at h
      generalize hr : prune r S = or at h
      cases ol <;> cases or <;> simp_all [restrictList_append]

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.prune_leaves
statement:
theorem prune_leaves [DecidableEq α] (t u : FullTree α)
    (S : Finset α) (h : prune t S = some u) :
    u.leaves = restrictList S t.leaves
proof:
:= by
  induction t generalizing u with
  | leaf a =>
      simp only [prune_leaf] at h
      by_cases ha : a ∈ S
      · simp only [ha, if_true, Option.some.injEq] at h
        subst u
        simp [restrictList, ha]
      · simp [ha] at h
  | fork l r ihl ihr =>
      simp only [prune] at h
      generalize hl : prune l S = ol at h
      generalize hr : prune r S = or at h
      cases ol with
      | none =>
          cases or with
          | none => simp at h
          | some r' =>
              simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h
              subst u
              rw [leaves_fork, restrictList_append,
                restrictList_eq_nil_of_prune_eq_none l S hl,
                List.nil_append]
              exact ihr r' hr
      | some l' =>
          cases or with
          | none =>
              simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h
              subst u
              rw [leaves_fork, restrictList_append,
                restrictList_eq_nil_of_prune_eq_none r S hr,
                List.append_nil]
              exact ihl l' hl
          | some r' =>
              simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h
              subst u
              simp only [leaves_fork, restrictList_append]
              rw [ihl l' hl, ihr r' hr]

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.eq_leaf_of_leaves_length_eq_one
statement:
theorem eq_leaf_of_leaves_length_eq_one (t : FullTree α)
    (h : t.leaves.length = 1) : ∃ a, t = leaf a
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | leaf a => exact ⟨a, rfl⟩
  | fork l r =>
      simp only [leaves_fork, List.length_append] at h
      have hl := leaves_length_pos l
      have hr := leaves_length_pos r
      omega

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.shape_of_leaves_length_eq_two
statement:
theorem shape_of_leaves_length_eq_two (t : FullTree α)
    (h : t.leaves.length = 2) : ∃ a b, t = fork (leaf a) (leaf b)
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | leaf a => simp at h
  | fork l r =>
      simp only [leaves_fork, List.length_append] at h
      have hlp := leaves_length_pos l
      have hrp := leaves_length_pos r
      have hl : l.leaves.length = 1 := by omega
      have hr : r.leaves.length = 1 := by omega
      obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := eq_leaf_of_leaves_length_eq_one l hl
      obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := eq_leaf_of_leaves_length_eq_one r hr
      exact ⟨a, b, rfl⟩

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.shape_of_leaves_length_eq_three
statement:
theorem shape_of_leaves_length_eq_three (t : FullTree α)
    (h : t.leaves.length = 3) :
    ∃ a b c,
      t = fork (leaf a) (fork (leaf b) (leaf c)) ∨
      t = fork (fork (leaf a) (leaf b)) (leaf c)
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | leaf a => simp at h
  | fork l r =>
      simp only [leaves_fork, List.length_append] at h
      have hlp := leaves_length_pos l
      have hrp := leaves_length_pos r
      rcases (show l.leaves.length = 1 ∧ r.leaves.length = 2 ∨
          l.leaves.length = 2 ∧ r.leaves.length = 1 by omega) with h12 | h21
      · obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := eq_leaf_of_leaves_length_eq_one l h12.1
        obtain ⟨b, c, rfl⟩ := shape_of_leaves_length_eq_two r h12.2
        exact ⟨a, b, c, Or.inl rfl⟩
      · obtain ⟨a, b, rfl⟩ := shape_of_leaves_length_eq_two l h21.1
        obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := eq_leaf_of_leaves_length_eq_one r h21.2
        exact ⟨a, b, c, Or.inr rfl⟩

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.shape_of_leaves_length_eq_four
statement:
theorem shape_of_leaves_length_eq_four (t : FullTree α)
    (h : t.leaves.length = 4) :
    ∃ a b c d,
      t = fork (leaf a) (fork (leaf b) (fork (leaf c) (leaf d))) ∨
      t = fork (leaf a) (fork (fork (leaf b) (leaf c)) (leaf d)) ∨
      t = fork (fork (leaf a) (leaf b)) (fork (leaf c) (leaf d)) ∨
      t = fork (fork (leaf a) (fork (leaf b) (leaf c))) (leaf d) ∨
      t = fork (fork (fork (leaf a) (leaf b)) (leaf c)) (leaf d)
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | leaf a => simp at h
  | fork l r =>
      simp only [leaves_fork, List.length_append] at h
      have hlp := leaves_length_pos l
      have hrp := leaves_length_pos r
      rcases (show l.leaves.length = 1 ∧ r.leaves.length = 3 ∨
          l.leaves.length = 2 ∧ r.leaves.length = 2 ∨
          l.leaves.length = 3 ∧ r.leaves.length = 1 by omega) with h13 | h22 | h31
      · obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := eq_leaf_of_leaves_length_eq_one l h13.1
        obtain ⟨b, c, d, hshape⟩ := shape_of_leaves_length_eq_three r h13.2
        rcases hshape with rfl | rfl
        · exact ⟨a, b, c, d, Or.inl rfl⟩
        · exact ⟨a, b, c, d, Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)⟩
      · obtain ⟨a, b, rfl⟩ := shape_of_leaves_length_eq_two l h22.1
        obtain ⟨c, d, rfl⟩ := shape_of_leaves_length_eq_two r h22.2
        exact ⟨a, b, c, d, Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))⟩
      · obtain ⟨a, b, c, hshape⟩ := shape_of_leaves_length_eq_three l h31.1
        obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := eq_leaf_of_leaves_length_eq_one r h31.2
        rcases hshape with rfl | rfl
        · exact ⟨a, b, c, d, Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)))⟩
        · exact ⟨a, b, c, d, Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)))⟩

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.multiset_move_across_four
statement:
private theorem multiset_move_across_four (x y : β) :
    y ::ₘ y ::ₘ y ::ₘ y ::ₘ {x} = x ::ₘ y ::ₘ y ::ₘ y ::ₘ {y}
proof:
:= by
  change y ::ₘ y ::ₘ y ::ₘ y ::ₘ x ::ₘ 0 =
    x ::ₘ y ::ₘ y ::ₘ y ::ₘ y ::ₘ 0
  rw [Multiset.cons_swap y x, Multiset.cons_swap y x,
    Multiset.cons_swap y x, Multiset.cons_swap y x]

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.crossingProfile_shape_one_three
statement:
theorem crossingProfile_shape_one_three [DecidableEq α] (a b c d : α) :
    crossingProfile (fork (leaf a) (fork (leaf b) (fork (leaf c) (leaf d)))) =
      4 • ({blockSplit a c b d, blockSplit a d b c} :
        Multiset (Circular.QuartetSplit α))
proof:
:= by
  simp [crossingProfile, frontierProfile, crossingList, blockSplit,
    show (4 : ℕ) = 3 + 1 by omega, succ_nsmul]
  simp only [Multiset.cons_swap]
  exact congrArg
    (fun s => Circular.splitOf a b c d ::ₘ Circular.splitOf a b c d ::ₘ s)
    (multiset_move_across_four (Circular.splitOf a b c d)
      (Circular.splitOf a b d c))

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.displayedSplit_shape_one_three
statement:
theorem displayedSplit_shape_one_three [DecidableEq α] (a b c d : α)
    (h : [a, b, c, d].Nodup) :
    displayedSplit (fork (leaf a) (fork (leaf b) (fork (leaf c) (leaf d)))) =
      blockSplit a b c d
proof:
:= by
  have ha := (List.nodup_cons.mp h).1
  have ht := (List.nodup_cons.mp h).2
  have hb := (List.nodup_cons.mp ht).1
  have htt := (List.nodup_cons.mp ht).2
  have hc := (List.nodup_cons.mp htt).1
  simp at ha hb hc
  rcases ha with ⟨hab, hac, had⟩
  rcases hb with ⟨hbc, hbd⟩
  have hcd : c ≠ d := hc
  have hdiff : ({a, b, c, d} : Finset α) \ {c, d} = {a, b} := by
    ext x
    simp
    aesop
  simp [displayedSplit, cherry?, leaves, blockSplit, Circular.splitOf, Circular.pair]
  rw [hdiff]
  exact Finset.pair_comm ({c, d} : Finset α) ({a, b} : Finset α)

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.blockSplit_ab_ne_ac
statement:
theorem blockSplit_ab_ne_ac [DecidableEq α] (a b c d : α)
    (h : [a, b, c, d].Nodup) :
    blockSplit a b c d ≠ blockSplit a c b d
proof:
:= by
  intro hs
  have hm : Circular.pair a b ∈ blockSplit a b c d := by
    simp [blockSplit, Circular.splitOf]
  rw [hs] at hm
  have ha := (List.nodup_cons.mp h).1
  have ht := (List.nodup_cons.mp h).2
  have hb := (List.nodup_cons.mp ht).1
  simp at ha hb
  rcases ha with ⟨hab, hac, had⟩
  rcases hb with ⟨hbc, hbd⟩
  simp [blockSplit, Circular.splitOf, Circular.pair] at hm
  rcases hm with hm | hm
  · have : b ∈ ({a, c} : Finset α) := by rw [← hm]; simp
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at this
    rcases this with hba | hbc'
    · exact hab hba.symm
    · exact hbc hbc'
  · have : a ∈ ({b, d} : Finset α) := by rw [← hm]; simp
    simp [hab, had] at this

proof:

    rcases this with hba | hbd'

name: QuartetDistance.Tree.FullTree.blockSplit_ac_ne_ad
statement:
theorem blockSplit_ac_ne_ad [DecidableEq α] (a b c d : α)
    (h : [a, b, c, d].Nodup) :

proof:
:= by
  intro hs
  have hm : Circular.pair a c ∈ blockSplit a c b d := by
